BackstoryDef.title: bridge maintainer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] maintained the bridges linking alliance settlements, replacing rotten planks and fitting salvaged metal into damaged supports. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to make repairs with whatever arrived on the supply cart, testing each joint before letting a loaded caravan cross.

BackstoryDef.title: seed curator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept the alliance's seed collections, testing small batches and comparing their growth with old planting records. When a familiar crop failed in unfamiliar soil, [PAWN_pronoun] recorded the differences carefully so the next settlement would not repeat the same mistake.

BackstoryDef.title: stove mason
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] built cooking stoves for alliance camps, altering fireboxes and flues to suit the fuel available. [PAWN_pronoun] always cooked a meal on a finished stove before handing it over, gradually learning as much about keeping a pot simmering as about laying its hearth.

BackstoryDef.title: trail scout
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] scouted routes for alliance supply teams, clearing growth from old trail markers and often firing a rifle to drive dangerous animals off the path. [PAWN_pronoun] learned which plants concealed a usable trail and marked detours around thickets better left undisturbed.

BackstoryDef.title: archive restorer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] repaired damp books for the alliance, deciphering missing words and mixing adhesives from old instructions. Preserving the original mattered so much to [PAWN_objective] that [PAWN_pronoun] eventually refused all decorative and artistic work, accepting only repairs guided by surviving objects and records.

BackstoryDef.title: quarantine inspector
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] checked symptoms and compared case records at an alliance quarantine station. A food contamination incident left [PAWN_objective] unwilling to cook for anyone again. Even a small omission during routine checks could make [PAWN_objective] anxious long after the shift ended.

BackstoryDef.title: sealed storekeeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] catalogued the contents of an alliance sealed store and maintained the packing fixtures. [PAWN_pronoun] could recall the markings on crates untouched for years. Long accustomed to written handovers, [PAWN_pronoun] eventually refused all negotiation and prisoner supervision, leaving dealings with people to the liaison staff.

BackstoryDef.title: veterinary surgeon
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] treated the alliance's livestock, learning to restrain frightened animals without worsening their wounds. After tending an animal injured by a poorly placed hunting shot, [PAWN_pronoun] refused to hunt again, though [PAWN_pronoun] remained willing to defend a threatened camp.

BackstoryDef.title: sparring partner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sparred with recruits at an alliance training hall, repeating close combat drills until both partners could move safely. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read a shifting shoulder and step clear before a practice weapon reached [PAWN_objective], often making an awkward exchange look effortless.

BackstoryDef.title: itinerant repairer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] traveled between small settlements repairing roofs and household tools. Years with a light pack taught [PAWN_objective] to prefer plain food and a bare sleeping corner. [PAWN_pronoun] came to find rich meals and ornate bedrooms uncomfortable even when hosts offered them freely.

BackstoryDef.title: supply appraiser
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] assessed traded supplies, comparing ledgers and explaining disputed prices to caravan crews. [PAWN_pronoun] became good at judging quality, but also began insisting on an impressive bedroom of [PAWN_possessive] own. A modest room could sour [PAWN_possessive] mood even after a profitable deal.

BackstoryDef.title: station caretaker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] maintained the doors, bunks and worn tools at an alliance waystation. [PAWN_pronoun] knew how to put most things right, but had grown fond of the long quiet intervals between arrivals. Work proceeded slowly, with frequent pauses whenever nothing seemed immediately urgent.

BackstoryDef.title: mechanical fitter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fitted machinery in an alliance workshop, consulting old drawings whenever replacement parts did not match. [PAWN_pronoun] trusted carefully repaired equipment, but recoiled from artificial limbs and deliberate alterations to living bodies, refusing to treat [PAWN_possessive] own body as another machine to rebuild.

BackstoryDef.title: ration supervisor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] checked ration accounts and settled disputes at an alliance distribution desk. [PAWN_pronoun] could explain a shortage clearly, but rarely softened an opinion for anyone's feelings. Complaints about [PAWN_possessive] cutting remarks often followed even a correctly resolved claim.

BackstoryDef.title: stoneware potter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made storage jars and tableware for alliance settlements, adjusting handles and rims to survive repeated use. [PAWN_pronoun] also pressed old decorative patterns into the wet clay, so even a plain kitchen shelf carried something recognizable from the homeworld.

BackstoryDef.title: mushroom farmer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tended mushroom beds in the cool cellars of alliance settlements, adjusting moisture and removing spoiled growth. Small harvests often went straight to the kitchen, where [PAWN_pronoun] learned how to turn varieties with very different textures into a dependable meal.

BackstoryDef.title: pattern weaver
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wove cloth for an alliance workshop, working from a small collection of inherited sample strips. When yarn was scarce, [PAWN_pronoun] rearranged the surviving colors into simpler patterns, keeping the old designs recognizable without wasting the available thread.

BackstoryDef.title: pack train guard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] guarded alliance pack trains, leading nervous animals past narrow crossings and keeping a short weapon ready when trouble approached. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to fight without letting the lead rope tangle, since a scattered herd could strand the whole convoy.

BackstoryDef.title: reclamation worker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] prepared abandoned sites for alliance resettlement, removing unsafe masonry and digging usable metal from buried foundations. [PAWN_pronoun] learned which walls could support another roof and which had to come down before anyone moved in.

BackstoryDef.title: ballistics recorder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept records at an alliance proving range, firing test groups and comparing their patterns with workshop specifications. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to distinguish a careless shot from a faulty sight, then wrote the findings clearly enough for the next repair crew to use.

BackstoryDef.title: camp negotiator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped newly arrived families find space in alliance camps, comparing household lists and settling arguments over crowded rooms. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to ask what each person actually needed before making promises, and to explain decisions to those who had to wait.

BackstoryDef.title: poultry keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] looked after the birds in an alliance settlement's poultry sheds, separating sick animals and treating minor injuries before they spread through a crowded pen. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to catch a frightened bird firmly without damaging its wings.

BackstoryDef.title: kiln burner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] operated an alliance works kiln, quarrying raw material nearby and adjusting the heat by the color of the firing chamber. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to spot unsuitable material before it ruined a batch of bricks the settlement was counting on.

BackstoryDef.title: funeral guide
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped alliance families prepare farewells for their dead, arranging keepsakes and speaking when relatives could not find the words. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to choose a simple setting and a few familiar songs without letting the ceremony overwhelm the people it was meant to comfort.

BackstoryDef.title: pattern cutter kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped cut garments during childhood, checking the settlement's measure books and pinning cloth around neighbors' shoulders and wing roots. The elders did the sewing, while [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read dimensions and recognize where a sleeve needed more slack.

BackstoryDef.title: map-reading child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] liked spreading the settlement's worn street maps on the floor and tracing roads by lamplight. Eventually adults began asking [PAWN_objective] the way. When a direction proved wrong, [PAWN_pronoun] checked the map again and openly corrected the mistake.

BackstoryDef.title: kiln child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up beside the settlement's pottery kiln, helping adults stack unfired pots and dig clay nearby. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to remove stones from the clay and began recognizing which deposits shaped easily and which tended to crack in the kiln.

BackstoryDef.title: orchard child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent childhood summers helping in the alliance's orchard, picking fruit, carrying water to the roots and checking older trees for split bark. [PAWN_pronoun] learned which branches would bear weight and which had weakened enough to need attention.

BackstoryDef.title: drying yard child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped turn grain and sliced fruit in the settlement's drying yard, covering the racks when rain arrived. During long damp spells, [PAWN_pronoun] also helped dry the grain beside a stove, learning to keep it from scorching before it could be stored.

BackstoryDef.title: grove warden child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] followed the settlement's grove wardens, tagging young trees and clearing fallen branches from paths. Before the rains, [PAWN_pronoun] helped brace the timber posts holding back loose soil, learning to protect both the saplings and the trail below.

BackstoryDef.title: old goods mender
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped the elders in a small mending room, learning to straighten bent hinges and fit replacement handles. [PAWN_pronoun] returned the repaired items to neighboring households, listening to any remaining problems and reporting them back to the adults.

BackstoryDef.title: journal lending child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] recorded loans from the settlement's small lending shelf, where old technical journals and novels passed between households. While waiting for borrowers, [PAWN_pronoun] read a few pages, and later used the ledger to remind people when a book needed returning.

BackstoryDef.title: range score keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped keep score at the militia range, checking target sheets from behind the firing line and adding up the results. During breaks, veterans occasionally supervised a few practice shots, then showed [PAWN_objective] what the marks revealed about [PAWN_possessive] aim and grip.

BackstoryDef.title: ferry child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up by the settlement ferry, helping adults patch the boarding ramp and secure loose rails. When livestock needed crossing, [PAWN_pronoun] calmed frightened animals on the bank and led them slowly aboard before handing over their ropes.

BackstoryDef.title: market child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran errands between market stalls during childhood, counting change and passing along messages. [PAWN_pronoun] listened to bargaining, gradually learning what each vendor would accept and when an interruption would be welcome rather than irritating.

BackstoryDef.title: spinning child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to spin in a settlement loft while listening to the older spinners talk. Once [PAWN_pronoun] could keep the thread reasonably even, [PAWN_pronoun] began matching colors and leaving small sample lengths for the weavers to try.

BackstoryDef.title: memorial garden child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped weed the memorial garden and water newly planted flowers. When the elders outlined a pattern around a marker, [PAWN_pronoun] carefully filled it with color, gradually remembering which flowers different visitors preferred to leave beside the stones.

BackstoryDef.title: paper mill child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up beside the settlement's paper mill, carrying bundles of soaked scrap fiber to the drying frames and turning the sheets once a day. [PAWN_pronoun] came to know every step between a torn uniform and a blank page.

BackstoryDef.title: herbalist's helper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] followed the settlement's herbalists as a child, learning the smell and shape of useful leaves and reading their names from a small guide. Whenever identification was uncertain, [PAWN_pronoun] brought back a sample for an adult instead of adding it to the medicine basket.

BackstoryDef.title: watch bell child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped care for the settlement's watch bell, oiling the mount, tightening supports and replacing worn rope under an elder's supervision. Curious about how the sound carried, [PAWN_pronoun] stayed after each repair to watch the next shift test the bell.
